warnings: Two lintel details. Marks are circled letters: the first reads 'A'; the second is a hand-drawn glyph that can read 'B' or Thai 'ข' — recorded 'B' because รูปตัด ก-ก carries 'A' along the lintel line and 'B' beside the columns, so the pair is A/B.

Lintel B's width and depth are pen-overwritten on the print (0.12→0.15? and 0.40); the overwritten values 0.15 x 0.40 and the bold 2-Ø12 / ป-Ø6 @0.15 are taken as the final reading. Confidence lowered.
Lintel A (0.07 x 0.25) has one bar top and one bottom with a single hairpin tie ป-Ø6 @0.15 — recorded as main_bar top 1 / bottom 1.
Bars printed Ø → type RB (§6); no steel grade is printed anywhere in the set.
